run.note: Run 2 completes the package begun by run 1 (see previous_run). Run 1's report files were retained and are cited unchanged; run 2 added the missing deliverables (00, 03, 04, 11, 15, 20, 21, 23, 24), re-verified the baseline independently, and obtained evidence run 1 could not because this machine has a populated vendor/ tree and a native PHP toolchain.

host.php_version: 8.3.33 (ZTS Visual C++ 2019 x64), native at C:\openemr-stack\php
host.docker_note: Docker CLI is installed but the engine CANNOT run: this is a Google Compute Engine VM without nested virtualization (VirtualizationFirmwareEnabled=False, VMMonitorModeExtensions=False), so WSL2 and the Docker Desktop engine VM never boot. Every openemr-cmd / docker compose workflow in CLAUDE.md is unusable here. Consequence for this audit: DB-backed, API, E2E and Selenium suites could not be executed; the isolated suite and all static analysis are unaffected.
host.filesystem_note: Repository lives on a Google Drive mount (G:). Measured ~28 KB/s effective throughput with ~92% of I/O spent on Drive metadata round-trips. All repository searches therefore use `git grep <pattern> HEAD`, which reads blobs from packfiles (~1s) instead of walking the filesystem (minutes, frequently timing out). This also pins every citation to an exact commit.

repository_baseline.fork_commit_subject: refactor(oe-module-faxsms): Fix SignalWire fax support in oe-module-faxsms (#12526)
repository_baseline.fork_commit_author_note: The fork tip is authored by an upstream OpenEMR maintainer and is an upstream PR merge - the first indication that this fork carries no local work.

working_tree_detail.handling: No pre-existing changed or untracked file was edited, staged, stashed, reset or removed. sites/default/sqlconf.php contains local DB credentials and was NEVER read into any artifact. Audit output was confined to docs/discovery/openemr-decision-evidence/ and tools/discovery/openemr-decision-evidence/.

repository_baseline.shallow_note: The clone is shallow. This does not weaken the central ancestry finding: `git merge-base HEAD upstream/master` resolves to HEAD itself and `git rev-list --count upstream/master..HEAD` is 0, both computed from refs present locally. It does limit deep historical archaeology (full blame across all history).
repository_baseline.node_modules_note: node_modules/ has 3 entries (effectively empty). Per the machine's local setup, npm ci cannot run on the Drive mount (EBADF / EPERM cascade); the front-end build runs off-mount at C:\openemr-stack\build and only artifacts are copied back.

upstream.note: The upstream remote already existed and points at the official repository; it was not modified.

upstream_refs_established.UPSTREAM_MASTER_NOTE: upstream/master advanced between run 1 (2026-07-21) and run 2 (2026-08-07). The stable tag is immutable, which is why all production drift conclusions are anchored to v8_2_0 and master is used only as supplementary evidence.
upstream_refs_established.tag_selection_method: Tags were ranked by creatordate, not lexically. v8_2_0 (2026-07-08) is the newest tag that is not a prerelease; the v8_1_*-test.<sha> tags are release-candidate builds and were excluded. Corroborated by the existence of upstream release branches rel-820 and release-prep/rel-820.

central_finding: The fork has ZERO commits of its own. `git rev-list --count upstream/master..HEAD` returns 0 and the merge-base with upstream/master is the fork SHA itself. Every file difference against upstream is upstream moving forward, never a local edit. Consequently `git diff HEAD upstream/master` must NOT be read as 'our changes' - the usual downstream-fork mental model is inverted here.

permitted_read_only_operations_performed: git fetch upstream --tags --prune (succeeded; full tag set retrieved)

secrets_policy.detail: See 15-security-compliance-code-evidence.md section 2 (Q43). Four docker-compose files x three GITHUB_COMPOSER_TOKEN* variables. All values [REDACTED] everywhere. sites/default/sqlconf.php (locally modified, contains DB credentials) was never read into any artifact.

previous_run.environment_limitations: vendor/ and node_modules/ were both EMPTY and no PHP/Composer toolchain was present, so Q31/Q37/Q55/Q70 could only be inferred from composer.json and composer.lock. Run 2 re-verified all four against the installed vendor/ tree and confirmed them.
